_comment: Example: register the lsp-mcp bridge to enable the codebase-discovery LSP navigation option. Save as .mcp.json in your project root (NOT settings.json — that file does not take mcpServers), or run: claude mcp add --scope user lsp -- /path/to/lsp-mcp -config /path/to/config.yaml. Replace BOTH paths below with ABSOLUTE paths to your built binary and your config.yaml. A language server (gopls / typescript-language-server / pylsp / ...) must be installed and runnable, or the lsp_* tools will not appear and the skill falls back to grep.
